posts.text: #affordablehousing #presidenttrump #saveamericaact “A big yawn.” That’s what President Trump calls the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act the first massive affordable housing bill Congress has passed in decades. Today, when asked whether he would sign the bill, Trump again said he didn’t know. This is a strange position for Trump to take for two important reasons. This video explains what they are and explains what Trump is focused on instead.
posts.summary: Trump dismissive of affordable housing legislation
